policy.resolution_rule: Use current official launch pages for discovery/status/deadline and the signed call-specific guides approved 16 September 2026 as the controlling authority for budget currency. The signed guides resolve the launch-page RON/EUR conflict in favor of RON/lei. Only status, deadline and call FEN allocation are published by this overlay; other facts remain absent until separately normalized.
